description_ru: Небольшое эссе о пользе пеших прогулок.
text:
I walk to work every day. It takes thirty minutes, and I love it. I think walking is the best exercise.

First, it is free. I do not need a ticket or a car. I only need comfortable shoes.

Second, I see many interesting things. I see old houses, little shops and friendly neighbours. In a bus, I see only the window and my phone.

Third, walking is good for my body and my head. After a walk, I feel strong and happy. I have good ideas, too.

So, why not try? Walk to the shop, to school or to your friend's house. Your legs will thank you.

focus_sounds.tip_ru: Кончик языка слегка между зубами, выдыхайте воздух; не заменяйте на «с» или «ф».
Округлите и вытяните губы вперёд, как для «у», потом быстро раскройте; не произносите «в».
В конце слова не оглушайте согласный: bad звучит с «д», а не «т»; тяните гласный перед ним.

questions.question: How does the writer go to work?
What does the writer need for walking?
What does the writer see in a bus?
questions.answer: Only the window and the phone.
